subject: info-dy
title: INFO.DY.------SOC.RT.
description: Chart on book p. 376 (R(AS)CM(II)-20). INFO-DY is the subject; SOC-RT (social reality) is the partner. From the subject: RT-ALGN (reality alignment), T-C-IMP (time continuum implications) and POL-P (political policies). From RT-ALGN: RT-INT-TR (reality initiative traits). From RT-INT-TR: AF-DY (affinity dynamics). From T-C-IMP: RE-ST (restructuralism). From POL-P: P-FC (particular focus), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of". From P-FC: POL-SIGN (political significance).
